value.rationale: The precisely motivated equality case problem for a new rectangular-grid upper-domination theorem is completely solved over an infinite, canonical width-two family. Four/six extremizers are classified despite exponentially many minimal dominating sets. The even-length paired-rung extremizers are nonindependent, revealing structure absent from the known numerical Γ=α identity. This is neither an arbitrary parameter slice nor a routine direct corollary.
